review_context: Fable red-team review of the planned L&E budget-output expectation audit.
finding_title: Budget-output expectation audit must classify allowed output, not just upstream driver findings.
finding_summary: The L&E QA chain needs a deterministic aggregate that proves whether each executable case must block amount budgeting, stay range or hours-only, or remain candidate-only after review.
observable_context: The repo already has executable L&E fixtures, fact binding, driver binding, driver impact, reviewed driver impact, blocked-driver review, and budget fact gold.
Those reports do not yet provide one per-case allowed-output decision that the UI and DAD exception patterning can consume.
The output must preserve candidate-only and no-submission boundaries.
observable_decision_logic: If critical driver facts are unresolved, amount budgeting must be blocked.
If facts are present but uncertainty remains, the allowed output should be range or hours-only pending human review.
If review evidence exists, the output may be candidate range after review, still not approved or submittable.
Every case needs exception labels and required next gates so DAD can group recurring failure modes.
solution_path: Add a labor_employment_budget_output_expectations report over executable L&E cases.
Emit allowed output state, blocker reasons, candidate exception labels, next gates, and no-write proof per case.
Wire the report into synthetic QA review and read-only UI data after tests are green.
applies_when: A reviewer identifies a hard or novel issue in intake budget math, driver ontology, authority boundaries, matter linking, synthetic QA, UI authority, or exception mapping.
The finding needs to survive beyond chat as a candidate DAD learning or exception-lake pattern.
does_not_apply_when: The finding is a routine typo or duplicate already captured in a tracked issue.
The finding requires raw private matter data, credentials, real client names, or long source payloads to be useful.
danger_if_misapplied: If this is treated as approved learning instead of candidate mail, DAD may promote unreviewed Fable advice across repos or create false confidence in budget outputs.
suggested_actions: DAD should classify this as a candidate red-team review issue and map it to exception-lake event classes.
Codex should implement the deterministic budget-output expectation audit with fixture and UI tests.
A human/DAD review gate should decide whether the pattern becomes a reusable learning rule.
reviewer_notes: This record is synthetic and metadata-only.
It intentionally summarizes observable decision logic and excludes hidden chain-of-thought.
red_team_notes: Do not let the UI display a total without candidate-only and blocked-action context.
Do not route this directly to Exception Lake; intake can only create candidate mail for DAD pickup.
